scope: Two distinct fixed reviewers each made one fresh whole-batch source review. Same content hashes can recur across independent reads; receipt timestamps and reviewer identities remain separate. Author and historical caches were not fresh-review evidence.
secondary_scope: Each immutable report/catalog names its own fresh secondary successes, explicit failed accesses and web observations. Failed/oversize reads are not cited as supporting evidence. Exact webtool request timestamps were not invented. Where compact HTTP text is captured without raw HTML, its catalog expressly says raw bytes were not retained.
review_timing_scope: Step2 author windows and the phased independent step3 review are distinct. Factual item source windows and quality full elapsed intervals including dictionary-lane/root-coordination waits are retained exactly in their reports; no false all-review-under300seconds claim.
original_to_retained_path_scope: Original reports remain byte-exact and may cite their temporary staging paths. This manifest maps retained evidence bytes to the preserved source setup; staging is removed only after matching all retained hashes.

mechanical_request_audit.scope: Offline timestamp/body/table-attachment integrity only, no third semantic source approval.
